J43_found_routing.instructions: Where do the three verified findings (waffle launches skipping koompi-launch, the waffle pin check, lookups on an empty class) go?

criteria.new_job_after_j44: A new job J45, queued right after J44, owning the waffle launch paths, the waffle pin check and the two empty-class lookups. Strongest case: keeps the no-refill decision, keeps J43 mergeable now, and gives one worker one coherent area (app identity and launch paths). Cost: the bugs wait behind J44 and the slot schedule.
criteria.j43_round2_now: Resume J43 for a round 2 now; it knows the code. Strongest case: least ramp-up, fixes land soonest. Cost: refills the slot the swarm decision said to leave empty, and J43's verified work waits to merge.

J43_restore_nodisplay.instructions: Should session restore relaunch NoDisplay desktop entries?

criteria.skip_nodisplay: Skip them like windows with no entry. Strongest case: they are not apps a user starts from a menu; relaunching kdialog bare opens nothing and its 90 s claim can steal a dialog onto another workspace. Cost: a NoDisplay entry that is a real window (a settings module opened by itself) does not come back.
criteria.keep_relaunching: Keep relaunching them. Strongest case: nothing that was open is dropped on purpose. Cost: pointless launches and a 90 s claim that can move an unrelated dialog.
